title: The Photon Requiem
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The last lightship of the Lumen Navy carries a cargo that was never meant to arrive: the recorded consciousness of the Navy\'s founder, preserved to be "reborn" at the end of a century-long war. When the war ends two decades early, navigator-priest Elian must decide whether the rebirth is a resurrection — or an occupation of the peace.
